band_origin.easy: Authored introductory f-prime/f recognition; sources have no easy labels
band_origin.moderate: Authored intermediate band: affine trig/power denominator plus coefficient adjustment; sources have no moderate labels
band_origin.hard: Source-anchored definite log evaluation, nested substitution, or supported rational rearrangement

sampling: Structural family first, then valid parameters. No zero definite answers or old task reuse. Both coefficient signs within each family.
response_policy: All new records use exact-entry blanks to assess the substitution directly. No source-bank fidelity claimed; original code and complete banks archived.
